name: Spotify
author: Sonic Liberation
description: Spotify plugin for Spotube metadata fetching (Android & Desktop compatible, Fixed pagination, Offline Liked Songs & Auto-Download on Like)
entryPoint:
SpotifyMetadataProviderPlugin

class PatchedAuthEndpoint {
  var inner
  construct (this.inner)
  get authStateStream => inner.authStateStream
  get credentials => inner.credentials
  get client => inner.client
  fun isExpired() => inner.isExpired()
  fun getExpirationDuration() => inner.getExpirationDuration()
  fun initializeFromLocalStorage() => inner.initializeFromLocalStorage()
  fun getLatestNuance() => inner.getLatestNuance()
  fun generateTimedOnTimePassword(secret: string) => inner.generateTimedOnTimePassword(secret)
  fun randomBytesFromMath(length: int) => inner.randomBytesFromMath(length)
  fun getToken({ mode = "transport", timestamp, totp: string, spDc: string, totpVer: int }) => inner.getToken(mode: mode, timestamp: timestamp, totp: totp, spDc: spDc, totpVer: totpVer)
  fun credentialsFromCookie(cookies: List) => inner.credentialsFromCookie(cookies)
  fun isAuthenticated() {
    if (inner.credentials != null && inner.credentials["cookies"] != null) {
      return true
    }
    return inner.isAuthenticated()
  }
  fun login(cookies: List) => inner.login(cookies)
  fun refreshCredentials() => inner.refreshCredentials()
  fun authenticate() => inner.authenticate()
  fun logout() => inner.logout()
}

class PatchedTrackEndpoint {
  var inner
  construct (this.inner)

  fun getTrack(id: string) => inner.getTrack(id)
  fun save(trackIds: List) => inner.client.track.save(trackIds)
  fun unsave(trackIds: List) => inner.client.track.unsave(trackIds)
  fun radio(trackId: string) => inner.radio(trackId)
}

class PatchedPlaylistEndpoint {
  var inner
  construct (this.inner)

  fun getPlaylist(id: string) => inner.getPlaylist(id)

  fun tracks(id: string, { offset: int, limit: int }) {
    if (offset != null && offset > 0) {
      return {
        limit: limit ?? 20,
        nextOffset: null,
        hasMore: false,
        total: 0,
        items: []
      }.toJson()
    }
    return inner.tracks(id, offset: 0, limit: 5000).then((data) {
      data["hasMore"] = false
      data["nextOffset"] = null
      data["limit"] = data["items"].length
      data["total"] = data["items"].length
      return data
    })
  }

  fun create(userId: string, { name: string, description: string, public: bool, collaborative: bool }) => inner.create(userId, name: name, description: description, public: public, collaborative: collaborative)
  fun update(playlistId: string, { name: string, description: string, public: bool, collaborative: bool }) => inner.update(playlistId, name: name, description: description, public: public, collaborative: collaborative)
  fun deletePlaylist(playlistId: string) => inner.deletePlaylist(playlistId)
  fun addTracks(playlistId: string, { trackIds: List, position: int }) => inner.addTracks(playlistId, trackIds: trackIds, position: position)
  fun removeTracks(playlistId: string, { trackIds: List }) => inner.removeTracks(playlistId, trackIds: trackIds)
  fun save(playlistId: string) => inner.save(playlistId)
  fun unsave(playlistId: string) => inner.unsave(playlistId)
}

class PatchedSpotifyPlugin {
  var inner
  var auth
  var api
  var album
  var artist
  var browse
  var playlist
  var search
  var track
  var user
  var core

  construct () {
    inner = plugin.SpotifyMetadataProviderPlugin()
    auth = PatchedAuthEndpoint(inner.auth)
    api = inner.api
    album = inner.album
    artist = inner.artist
    browse = inner.browse
    playlist = PatchedPlaylistEndpoint(inner.playlist)
    search = inner.search
    track = PatchedTrackEndpoint(inner.track)
    core = inner.core
    user = PatchedUserEndpoint(inner.user)
  }
}

Plugin = PatchedSpotifyPlugin
